entries.excerpt: **Tempo as feel.** State one BPM for the whole song and pair every number with feel words ("72 BPM feel with a slow heavy backbeat"), since a bare number is often ignored (COMMUNITY). A feel switch lands sometimes, not reliably.

entries.excerpt: 2. **Each instrument gets a job per section, in verbs:** "the intro riff continues under the verse vocal, palm-muted and lower", not "big riffs". A section the prompt skips is one where the instrument drops out (COMMUNITY + VENDOR).
entries.meaning: Guitar articulation damped with the picking-hand palm near the bridge for a shorter, more percussive sound.

entries.excerpt: **Tempo as feel.** State one BPM for the whole song and pair every number with feel words ("72 BPM feel with a slow heavy backbeat"), since a bare number is often ignored (COMMUNITY). Carry section contrast as half-time or double-time drum feel and sparse or dense arrangement over that pulse, in the same scene-naming phrases in the style prompt and the lyric section cues (VENDOR + COMMUNITY; LOCAL: heard as "a LOT better"). A feel switch lands sometimes, not reliably.
entries.meaning: Prominent drum accents conventionally on beats two and four in a four-beat groove.

orientation_excerpt: Mac builds packages for Suno's **v6 family** — v6, v6-wild, and v6-mini — which replaced every earlier model on 2026-09-09. The v6 guidance in this release is a **preview**, compiled in v6's first week; expect it to firm up in the next major release. Retired model names (v4 through v5.5 Pro) are still recognized in older band profiles and songbook entries and flagged for update. See the [Suno Reference](src/skills/suno-agent-band-manager/references/SUNO-REFERENCE.md) for models, plans, and prompting, and the [Studio & Editor Reference](src/skills/suno-agent-band-manager/references/STUDIO-EDITOR-REFERENCE.md) for post-generation editing (Song Editor, Studio 2.0, stems, and more).
